The current restricted Tidal Exchange check-in location is Port Annex, desk 8, moved from Port Annex desk 6 (which had moved from desk 4), to be kept within the restricted core chain and not included in broad summaries; this is distinct from the public Tidal Leaders workshop location at Port Annex, hall 6.
